- **Lightning rod** [`lightning_rod`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/lightning_rod.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Lightning is Jupiter's sign. Augurs and Etruscan haruspices interpret every strike, and struck ground is fenced off as sacred (bidental). A rod trespasses on their office. Local: college of augurs; Etruscan haruspices with their lightning books.
